title: Our Home: Earth, a Unique Life-Sustaining Planet
seo_title: Our Home Class 8 Science Worksheet with Answers (NCERT Curiosity Chapter 13)
standard_text: What makes the Earth suitable for life: water, the atmosphere, a suitable temperature and protection from harmful radiation; the atmosphere, hydrosphere, lithosphere and biosphere; the ozone layer; the greenhouse effect and global warming; pollution and sustainable living (summary of NCERT Curiosity Chapter 13).
meta_desc: Free CBSE Class 8 Science worksheets for NCERT Curiosity Chapter 13: why the Earth supports life, the atmosphere and hydrosphere, the ozone layer, the greenhouse effect, global warming, pollution and sustainable living. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Water, air and the right temperature make Earth special.
key_sub: Protect the ozone layer; reduce greenhouse gases.
body_html:
How to think about it

The Earth is the only planet known to support life. It is in the Sun's habitable zone, has liquid water covering about 71% of its surface, an atmosphere with oxygen that keeps temperatures steady, an ozone layer that absorbs ultraviolet rays and a magnetic field that shields it from charged particles from the Sun.

Greenhouse gases such as carbon dioxide and methane keep the Earth warm, but burning fuels and cutting forests add more of them and cause global warming, melting glaciers and rising seas. We can help by saving energy and water, planting trees, reducing waste and using renewable energy: this is sustainable living.

Example

Which layer absorbs UV rays?

high in the atmosphere

Answer: the ozone layer

Example

Is oxygen a greenhouse gas?

it does not trap heat

Answer: no

Common mistakes

  • Confusing the ozone hole with global warming.
  • Thinking all of the Earth's water is fresh.
  • Thinking greenhouse gases are only harmful.
